verdict.rationale: The only route to getting data out is indirect: the API programmatically manages domains, account settings, DNS and orders, and the MCP server can view domains, account info and DNS records, so an AI-native user could pull account data with custom scripting. There is no documented export feature, no stated open export format, and no documented transfer-out path for leaving (the transfer pages cover moving domains in only). Missing for 10: a documented bulk data export, open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/zone files), a documented outbound domain transfer process, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
